Stacked on #341306, which is stacked on #341301.

## Summary

- keep built-in/provider sources such as MCP Gallery, GitHub Feed, and Copilot Connectors at the top of the source menu
- place repository-backed plugin marketplaces below those providers
- sort repository marketplace sources case-insensitively by display name
- apply the same ordering to active and all-source metadata

## Validation

- `npm run typecheck-client` — passed
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/aiCustomization/customizationMarketplaceWorkbenchService.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/aiCustomization/customizationMarketplaceWorkbenchService.test.ts` — passed
- `./scripts/test.sh --reporter dot --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/aiCustomization/customizationMarketplaceWorkbenchService.test.ts` — passed (31 tests)

Scenarios.Scenario: Open or refresh the customization marketplace source picker and all-source metadata
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The page's updateSources reads marketplaceService.sources once, constructs source metadata, sorts only repository-backed plugin/provider entries in memory, then renders the source button/menu. allSources is read for warnings and configuration/source-change handling. No subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, or network operation is reached by the added sort.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: The effective number of policy-allowed, deduplicated configured plugin marketplaces plus harness-reported provider marketplaces; built-in/platform sources are not included in the sort.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous single-threaded array copy and O(S log S) comparison; source-change refreshes are event-driven rather than frame- or row-driven.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Source metadata getters are recomputed on access both before and after the PR; the PR adds one bounded sorted copy. No cache key, negative cache, or remote cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: getter consumers and render paths were traced, including the detail renderer's constant-number source lookups and the discovery page's cached marketplaceSources snapshot.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Users can configure varying marketplace counts, but realistic counts are small and accesses occur on page/source refresh rather than per frame. The added CPU/allocation is not plausibly user-visible.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The new in-memory sort has bounded, small cardinality and is not on a high-frequency rendering path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Browse/search customization catalogs across all enabled sources and continue pagination
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Search input is coalesced by a 300 ms scheduler. Each request reads the sorted sources getter, filters enabled sources, then awaits CustomizationMarketplaceService.query; the query service retains its pre-existing provider-array order and starts providers with Promise.all. Thus the metadata reorder does not add boundary calls, serialize them, or move them onto a new critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Queries configured/default MCP gallery pages through IMcpGalleryService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Up to one call for each active custom/default MCP gallery provider that needs a page; unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same providers and page calls were selected; request source-ID order did not control provider launch order.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited as part of the concurrent all-source catalog request.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Reads each selected plugin marketplace via raw GitHub requests or clone-backed repository discovery.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One configured, policy-allowed repository per enabled plugin source on a cold query; warm TTL caches avoid the remote read. Unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same enabled configured repositories were queried with the same cache and concurrency behavior.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited by its provider, concurrently with other selected marketplace providers.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Delegates marketplace queries to the active harness search/management provider, whose transport is owned outside this service.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One call per enabled harness feed/provider needing a page; unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same harness provider calls occurred; only display metadata order changed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited concurrently with other marketplace sources.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Loads or reuses the Copilot connectors catalog snapshot, with remote refresh owned by ICopilotConnectorsService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one snapshot load per query when the connector source is enabled, with a 60-second service refresh window and continuation reuse; unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Connector selection, caching, and remote refresh behavior were identical.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited concurrently with other selected providers.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One logical provider query per enabled provider, after source grouping: MCP Gallery has up to custom/default providers under one source, each configured plugin marketplace has one provider, and enabled harness/connectors/platform providers participate as before. Pagination reuses continuation state and only refills exhausted provider buffers.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: All provider states needing data start concurrently via the existing Promise.all. Plugin repository fetches are also concurrent over selected references; because each plugin provider selects one canonical marketplace, effective plugin fetch cardinality remains one repository per enabled plugin source. The PR neither increases nor caps concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Combined pages use an LRU continuation cache of 32 entries with 30-minute expiry. Plugin GitHub repositories use persisted positive TTL cache, cloned repositories use their existing TTL behavior, and connector pages/snapshots use existing continuation and 60-second refresh caching. Sorting changes neither cold/warm keys nor invalidation/coalescing.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: source-ID creation, provider filtering, Promise.all fan-out, continuation state, and repository/connector cache paths were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider count and cold-network duration vary by user configuration, but the before/after call count and scheduling are established as identical.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Sorting metadata adds small local work before the request but does not alter expensive boundary cardinality, cache behavior, or effective concurrency.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render and expose accessibility content for a selected marketplace detail
Scenarios.CriticalPath: EmbeddedMarketplaceDetail asks getSourceLabel once during visual render and once when accessibility content is requested. Each call reads sources and performs a linear find; the PR adds sorting of the small repository-source subset before that lookup. README/media loading remains the existing independent detail path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of configured/provider marketplaces, with a constant number of source-label lookups per selected detail rather than one per result row or animation frame.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous metadata lookup only; no new concurrent work or queue is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No source-label cache existed before or after. Detail resource and remote preview behavior are unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: both getSourceLabel call sites in EmbeddedMarketplaceDetail and the callback supplied by AICustomizationManagementEditor were inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact source count varies, but execution multiplicity is constant per detail render and the work remains small.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The added sort is not repeated per result row and is too bounded to establish rendering jank or meaningful latency.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over both changed files and all diff pages. The PR adds bounded in-memory sorting to source metadata getters. Traced UI consumers, catalog query fan-out, continuation/cache behavior, and remote/filesystem-capable providers; no expensive boundary count, concurrency, lifecycle, or cache behavior changes, and no actionable performance regression was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
